== Summary ==
Screenshot of the archived Decipher card-list index, captured 2 October 2002 at 22:07:30 UTC. The Virtual Card Sets introduction and section are absent; the product list begins with Theed Palace. Screenshot taken 14 November 2026. This demonstrates a changed listing, not deletion of the separate PDF files.
